name: Doddy And Haddzy Bonanza

features.name: 2x–100x multipliers
features.description: A random multiplier symbol appears during free spins.

features.name: Assured-trigger buy
features.description: The bonus buy ensures free spins on the next spin.

review:
A Viking Bonanza made with two popular streamers. Symbols pay anywhere, reels refill, and wins can chain within one spin.

Four or more scatters (which also pay anywhere) start free spins, where a multiplier symbol lands worth anything from 2x to 100x. Mechanically it's the same as Aztec Magic Bonanza, so pick it for the Viking look. High volatility, 10,200x max, 96% RTP. Be patient: free spins average about once every 398 spins.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus is rare (about 1 in 398 spins on average)
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
